title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
abstract: arXiv:2608.15459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention

translated_title: 并非所有注意力都是平等的：EEI权衡的定量综述
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15459v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：注意力机制推动了机器学习十年的发展，从神经机器翻译到执行通用推理的语言模型。本综述涵盖四个相互关联的主题：它们在序列到序列任务中的表述、对计算机视觉的适应、解决二次方瓶颈的效率创新，以及可解释性的进展。我们定义了三个标准：效率、表达性和可解释性，并使用EEI评分框架比较了二十一种方法。评分来自单一评分者，假设有±1分的扰动范围。基于20万样本的确定性蒙特卡洛分析表明，在此扰动模型下，平均67-70%的样本中排名变化超过一个位置。排名匹配的零模型重现了相似的稳定性特征，因此结果支持粗略的层级比较，而非精细的排名。综述追溯了注意力的发展历程。
tldr: 该综述通过EEI评分框架定量比较21种注意力方法，发现排名稳定性有限，仅支持粗略层级比较，而非精细排序。
en_tdlr: This survey quantitatively compares 21 attention methods using an EEI scoring framework, finding limited ranking stability that supports only coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings.
